_comment: Single source for the repository labels. .github/workflows/labels.yml syncs this file on every push to main. Labels listed under remove are deleted; labels in neither list are left alone.

labels.name: type:errata
labels.description: Typo, wrong number, broken link, contradiction

labels.name: type:evidence
labels.description: Add, correct or challenge a source

labels.name: type:rfc
labels.description: New module, new patch or change to core logic

labels.name: scope:book
labels.description: Fix lands in the manuscript, not in the spec

labels.name: status:triage
labels.description: New, not yet reviewed by the maintainer

labels.name: status:needs-source
labels.description: Consensus Gate: claim lacks a primary source or tier

labels.name: status:blocked-cla
labels.description: Held until the CLA is in force or signed

labels.name: tier:3-experimental
labels.description: TIER 3: non-standard or unverified, sandbox only

labels.name: tier:unaudited
labels.description: Not yet run through the audit pipeline

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: Out of scope for the spec
